caption_L2L3: The number of Toyota cars sold in Finland was approximately 12000-15000 per year over the time period shown. Overall, the number of cars sold reduced from 2009 to 2015, and then increased from 2015 to 2019. The fewest cars were sold in 2015. The most cars were sold in 2019.
